subject.title: [Feature]: Overview should show config file path

question: Should OpenClaw accept a prominent Control UI Overview row for the existing admin-scoped configPath snapshot field, move the path to Settings, or rely on CLI/config tooling only?
rationale: The technical path is small and source-backed, but the request is a new prominent UI exposure point for an absolute local path and needs maintainer UX placement intent before the linked PR can be treated as final.

options.title: Accept the Overview row
options.body: Land the linked presentation-only PR after redacted running Control UI proof confirms the active config path appears from the existing snapshot field.

options.title: Move it to Settings
options.body: Ask for the same existing config path to be surfaced in a Settings or Config information row instead of the Overview snapshot card.

options.title: Keep CLI only
options.body: Close this request if maintainers decide `openclaw config path` and existing config surfaces are enough for troubleshooting.

recommendation.title: Accept the Overview row
recommendation.body: Land the linked presentation-only PR after redacted running Control UI proof confirms the active config path appears from the existing snapshot field.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev has the clearest feature-history signal for the Overview view structure that would receive this UI row.
